# Supabase browser client

`supabase-2.119.0.js` is the unchanged UMD bundle from `@supabase/supabase-js@2.119.0`.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@supabase/supabase-js/-/supabase-js-2.119.0.tgz

SHA-256: `a867edbcfb029370aeec7223dd6180b560b621fbe3bc64c6584fb0369d1b7bce`

The MIT license is in `supabase-LICENSE`. The pinned bundle handles PKCE sign-in, session persistence, refresh, and sign-out. It keeps the site build independent of a package install.
